externalDocs.description: Data Dictionary for Address Lookup Service (September 2023)

info.description: Hong Kong Address Lookup Service and GeoAddress Lookup Service. The version is an OpenAPI metadata placeholder; no publisher API version is specified. Authentication requirements are not documented. For the `t` parameter on `/lookup`, the Data Dictionary (version 3.1, September 2023) specifies a default of 35, while the official resource description specifies 20; this conflict is retained here as a documented discrepancy.
info.title: Address Lookup Service

get.description: Looks up address records using a GeoAddress, a 19-character standardized identifier for a corresponding building or address. The documented identifier consists of ten leading digits derived from HK1980 grid coordinates with leading 8 digits removed, a `P` (podium) or `T` (tower) character, and an address record creation date in YYYYMMDD form. Request and response are encoded in UTF-8.

get.description: Looks up address records from free-text address elements and may return addresses with similar spelling or pronunciation. Request and response are encoded in UTF-8. Results are ordered in decreasing similarity. The response structure is supported by the publisher's dictionary and one documented JSON observation; that observation does not establish universal requiredness or a complete response contract.

parameters.description: Tolerance on returned record scores. Controls the range of scores below the highest score; for example, a highest score of 75 with tolerance 10 returns scores 65–75. When used with `n`, both conditions apply. The Data Dictionary specifies default 35; the official resource description specifies default 20, so the default is disputed.
